rules.statement: Possession by an agent acting in disparate capacities cannot be adverse if the dualism is not clearly manifested through unambiguous conduct.
rules.supporting_quote: "The only material before us on this matter is that Jayaneris planted 'catch crops' on the land. There is no evidence of a division of this produce between two sets of principals nor is there such a demarcation of the crops as to lend colour to the suggestion that he played a dual role."
